snippet.title: Demon Baby Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Demon Baby is a colorful 3D platforming adventure about Finn, a Viking who journeys into a strange and dangerous world to rescue his adopted demon daughter, Lumi.

Explore mysterious environments, overcome deadly traps, battle demons, uncover hidden secrets, and master challenging platforming. Play the full story campaign or test your skills in a dedicated Speedrun mode built for competitive runs.
